light.gate-courtyard: Viewed: both leaves, attached straps and latch, clear centre joint and sill above the drive. Member-specific wood grain remains T-2226 material work.
light.gate-alley: Viewed: outward boards and threshold fit the opening and grade; no new gap or contact defect. Dark shade is retained for T-2226 lighting review.
